h: NDC sacks Borno House of Assembly candidate Mohammed Bunu over alleged anti-party activities
p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly removed Mohammed Bunu as its candidate for a Borno State House of Assembly seat, accusing him of anti-party activities ahead of the 2027 election.
more: The party is expected to name a replacement ahead of the INEC deadline.
The move comes as the NDC unveils its national campaign council.
